data.narrative:
Tritone Technologies is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Ofer Ben-Zur. The valuation assessment relies on a peer-median approach using four same-sector, same- or adjacent-stage comparables: Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C). This peer set represents the closest available reference points within Robotics & Manufacturing at comparable funding stages, supplemented by a broader comp universe of 8 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable.

The peer-median method yields $1.6B as the central valuation estimate, with the peer set spanning a $1.0B–$1.8B range. This single applicable triangulation method produces a valuation corridor of $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), with $1.6B as the median point. The narrow methodological base reflects limited availability of directly comparable Series B robotics exits or recent financings with disclosed terms.

Key valuation uncertainties center on (1) stage-blending effects, as two comparables are Series C rather than Series B, which may inflate the estimate; (2) heterogeneity in business model and market focus within the peer set; and (3) absence of revenue, unit economics, or growth rate data for Tritone or its peers. A valuation in the $1.4B–$1.9B range is supported by comparable pricing, though the lack of independent secondary methods limits conviction. Additional data on Tritone's revenue traction or capital efficiency relative to peers would refine this estimate.
